address: 2900 E Barnett Rd Suite 1, Medford, OR 97504

fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Driveway; Vehicle Parking Area; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area; Walkway; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Vegetation Near Structure; Limited Side Access
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address markers visible from both directions on the street.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the residence without obstruction.
• Trim vegetation along the sides of the driveway to maintain a clear path to the front of the residence.
• Cut back any shrubs or low-hanging branches near the main residence that could slow or block responders moving around the building.
• Keep a clear walking path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings quickly.
• Mark or label the detached structure with a visible identifier to help responders distinguish it from the main residence during an emergency.
• If a gate or barrier limits side access to the property, keep it unlocked or install a Knox-style lock to allow responders through without delay.
• Keep the lawn area adjacent to the residence free of stored equipment, materials, or vehicles that could block responder staging or movement.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Open Terrain; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Scattered Shrubs; Multiple Access Routes
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that hang over or touch the structure.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure to increase open space between them.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure.
• Separate shrub clusters near the structure so individual shrubs are not touching each other.
• Keep the area immediately around the structure clear of dead leaves, twigs, and plant debris.
• Maintain open terrain areas around the structure free of encroaching shrub or tree growth.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation.
